page.overview:
Who is Charon?

Charon is the Ferryman of Hades war carried the newly deceased across the River Styx and Acheron that divides the World of the living from the World of the Dead.

Whie Heracles was doing his five great labors King Eurystheus of Mycenae told Him to get Cerebus. Heracles went down to the underworld and Charon just let Heracles on for free. On his way to the throne room of Hades he sees the hero Theseus sitting frozen on a rock and frees him. He talks to Hades and borrows Cerebus for his trial.

After the hero Orpheus lost his wife he went down Erobos so he could get her back. He Sings such a sad song that Charon lets him on for free. Orpheus soon loses his wife forever.

In [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Lightning_Thief Percy Jackson and the Olympians:Lightning Thief ] Percy,Annabeth and Grover pay Charon all of there drachmas to cross the River Styx to go to the Chambers of Hades.
